## Walkthrough Adds TLS support for image caching: a Secret-backed TLS volume is created and mounted into the image-downloader init container; cache URLs are rewritten from HTTP to HTTPS with a different port; TLS CA bytes are generated and stored in the TLS Secret. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Image cache runtime**
`provisioning/image_cache.go`|Added a Secret-backed TLS volume (`ironicTlsVolume`), changed cache URL transformation to use `https` and `ironicPrivatePort`, and mounted the TLS volume plus CA env var into the machine OS downloader init container.| |**Image cache tests**
`provisioning/image_cache_test.go`|Updated `TestGetImageVolumes` to expect the TLS Secret volume. Added `TestTransformURL` to validate URL rewriting to `https://metal3-state..svc.cluster.local:6388/...` and error handling for invalid input.| |**TLS generation**
`provisioning/baremetal_crypto.go`|`TlsCertificate` now includes `caCertificate []byte`; `generateTlsCertificate` extracts and returns CA PEM bytes alongside cert/key.| |**TLS secret creation**
`provisioning/baremetal_secrets.go`|`createOrUpdateTlsSecret` now includes the generated CA certificate as `ca.crt` in the Secret data.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Init as Init Container participant Secret as TLS Secret (Volume) participant Service as metal3-state Service participant Cache as Image Cache (proxy) Init->>Secret: Mount TLS secret volume Init->>Init: Read CA cert from env path (/var/run/m3tls/ironic/ca.crt) Init->>Cache: Request transformed HTTPS URL Cache->>Service: Connect to metal3-state over https:6388 using CA Service-->>Cache: Serve image (TLS) Cache-->>Init: Provide cached image via secure connection ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. ### ❌ Failed checks (1 warning, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :---------------------------------: | :------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 12.50% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ❓ Inconclusive | Cannot locate test files mentioned in PR summary (provisioning/image_cache_test.go). Repository contains no Ginkgo test files with dynamic test name patterns. | Verify that test files are committed and accessible in the repository. Examine test names in It(), Describe(), Context() patterns for dynamic values like fmt.Sprintf, timestamps, or namespace names. |
